welcome.subtitle.en: Ground your story. Shape your world.

workspace.choose.zh-CN: 选择河图洛书作品文件夹
workspace.choose.en: Choose a Hetu Luoshu book folder

bible.description.zh-CN: 由作者维护的人物、地点、势力、时序、世界观与创作规则。
bible.description.en: Author-defined characters, locations, factions, chronology, world notes, and writing rules.

bible.lock_detail.zh-CN: 锁定后需由作者主动解锁才能编辑。Agent 始终不能修改设定集。
bible.lock_detail.en: Editing a locked Story Bible requires the author to unlock it. Agents cannot modify it.

character.empty_detail.zh-CN: 先添加一个角色，逐步整理作品设定。
character.empty_detail.en: Add a character to begin organizing your story references.

document.revision_note.zh-CN: 保存会保留当前版本；定稿需要单独确认。
document.revision_note.en: Saving creates a text revision. Final approval is a separate review decision.

statistics.count.zh-CN: 汉字 {han} · 英文词 {words} · 总字符 {characters}
statistics.count.en: {han} Han characters · {words} English words · {characters} total characters

statistics.rule.zh-CN: 汉字与英文词分别统计；总字符包括标点和空白，按完整 Unicode 字符计数。
statistics.rule.en: Han characters and English words are counted separately. Total characters include punctuation and spaces, counted as Unicode grapheme clusters.

draft.submitted.zh-CN: 已提交 · 等待作者审核

draft.readonly.zh-CN: 此处预览 Agent 提交的原始内容，不会覆盖正式正文。
draft.readonly.en: Preview the original submitted content. Manuscript revisions remain separate.

unsaved.detail.zh-CN: 可以保存正文修订，或仅保留本机恢复副本。选择取消可继续编辑。
unsaved.detail.en: Save a manuscript revision or keep a local recovery copy. Cancel to continue editing.

recovery.detail.zh-CN: 请选择要恢复的副本。恢复保留原版本基线；磁盘正文有变动时，保存前会提示冲突。
recovery.detail.en: Choose a recovery copy. Its original revision is retained; changes on disk will require conflict review before saving.

conflict.available.zh-CN: 正文已有其他修订，编辑内容已保留
conflict.available.en: Another revision exists. Your edits are preserved.

conflict.detail.zh-CN: 比较后可将磁盘修订设为新基线，保留编辑器中的文本。再次保存会创建新修订。
conflict.detail.en: After comparing, use the disk revision as the new baseline while keeping your editor text. Save again to create a revision.

conflict.use_baseline.zh-CN: 保留编辑内容，采用新基线
conflict.use_baseline.en: Keep Edits and Use New Baseline

error.generic.zh-CN: 操作未完成，内容已保留。请检查工作区后重试。
error.generic.en: The action could not be completed. Your content is preserved. Check the workspace and try again.

error.recovery.zh-CN: 无法保存本机恢复副本，请检查磁盘空间与权限。请勿关闭窗口。
error.recovery.en: Unable to save a local recovery copy. Check disk space and permissions. Keep this window open.

error.invalid_input.zh-CN: 输入不符合要求，请检查名称、格式或内容长度。
error.invalid_input.en: Check the name, format, and content length.

error.not_found.zh-CN: 未找到内容，请刷新列表或重新打开作品。
error.not_found.en: Content was not found. Refresh the lists or reopen the workspace.

error.revision_conflict.zh-CN: 正文已有新修订。请比较版本后再保存，当前编辑内容已保留。
error.revision_conflict.en: A newer manuscript revision exists. Compare versions before saving. Your edits are preserved.

error.hetu.blueprint_locked.zh-CN: 设定集已锁定，请先由作者解锁。
error.hetu.blueprint_locked.en: The Story Bible is locked. The author must unlock it first.

error.hetu.stale_evidence.zh-CN: 设定集已更新，请刷新后重新操作。
error.hetu.stale_evidence.en: The Story Bible has changed. Refresh and try again.

error.hetu.io_failure.zh-CN: 文件操作未完成，请检查磁盘空间与访问权限。原保存操作会使用相同标识重试。
error.hetu.io_failure.en: A file operation failed. Check disk space and access permissions. Retrying the save will use its original operation key.

error.hetu.integrity_failure.zh-CN: 工作区文件与记录不一致。内容已保留，请检查文件后重新打开。
error.hetu.integrity_failure.en: Workspace files do not match their records. Your edits are preserved. Check the files and reopen the workspace.

error.hetu.recovery_required.zh-CN: 有未完成的文件事务，请检查工作区文件后重试原操作。
error.hetu.recovery_required.en: A file transaction requires recovery. Check workspace files and retry the original operation.

error.hetu.unsafe_path.zh-CN: 无法安全访问文件，请检查权限、符号链接与硬链接。
error.hetu.unsafe_path.en: Files could not be accessed safely. Check permissions, symbolic links, and hard links.

error.hetu.workspace_busy.zh-CN: 作品正在被另一进程写入，请稍后重试。
error.hetu.workspace_busy.en: Another process is writing to this workspace. Try again shortly.

bible.history_detail.zh-CN: 只读查看选定修订；不会将历史内容覆盖到当前设定。
bible.history_detail.en: View a saved revision without replacing the current Story Bible.

entity.empty_detail.zh-CN: 添加作者确认的设定。内容保存前会检查引用与时间关系。
entity.empty_detail.en: Add author-confirmed entries. References and chronology are checked before saving.

entity.remove_detail.zh-CN: 将移除“{name}”的当前设定，历史修订仍保留。存在其他设定引用时会阻止移除。
entity.remove_detail.en: Remove “{name}” from the current Story Bible. Historical revisions are retained. Referenced entries cannot be removed.

fact.needs_event.zh-CN: 先在时间线添加事件，再为可变事实指定有效期。
fact.needs_event.en: Add timeline events before assigning validity intervals to changing facts.

fact.interval_detail.zh-CN: 有效期包含起点，不包含截止事件。未指定截止不代表其他时段的事实已确认。
fact.interval_detail.en: Intervals include the start and exclude the end event. An open end does not establish facts outside the stated interval.

timeline.order_detail.zh-CN: 时序按故事中的先后定义，不以章节顺序推断。
timeline.order_detail.en: Define the order within the story independently of chapter order.

timeline.tick_detail.zh-CN: 同一历法中的整数刻度可比较先后，相同刻度表示同时；不同历法不自动换算。
timeline.tick_detail.en: Integer ticks are ordered within the same calendar. Equal ticks are simultaneous; different calendars are not automatically converted.

rule.exception.author_review.zh-CN: 允许作者审阅具体例外
rule.exception.author_review.en: Allow Author Review of Specific Exceptions

rule.scope_detail.zh-CN: 内容包必须至少选一个；文档或实体不选时覆盖该内容包的全部对应对象。多个筛选条件同时满足才适用。
rule.scope_detail.en: Choose at least one package. Empty document or entity selections include all corresponding objects. When set, all filters must match.

rule.term_exceptions.zh-CN: 允许出现的完整短语（每行一个）

rule.advisory_detail.zh-CN: 提醒供作者或 Agent 参考，不会自动判定人物性格或剧情合理性。
rule.advisory_detail.en: Advisories guide authors and agents without automatically judging characterization or plot plausibility.

error.bible_conflict.zh-CN: 设定集已有新修订，请刷新列表、核对变更后重新保存。
error.bible_conflict.en: The Story Bible has a newer revision. Refresh, compare the changes, and save again.

error.hetu.reference_in_use.zh-CN: 关联对象不存在或仍被引用，请检查角色事实、势力、地点、事件与规则范围。
error.hetu.reference_in_use.en: A reference is missing or still in use. Check character facts, factions, locations, timeline events, and rule scope.

error.hetu.location_cycle.zh-CN: 地点的父子关系形成循环，请检查所属地点。
error.hetu.location_cycle.en: Parent locations form a cycle. Check the location hierarchy.

error.hetu.timeline_cycle.zh-CN: 事件先后、历法刻度或事实有效期互相矛盾，请检查时间关系。
error.hetu.timeline_cycle.en: Event order, calendar ticks, or fact intervals contradict each other. Check the chronology.

error.hetu.fact_conflict.zh-CN: 同一角色在同一已知时段有互相矛盾的明确事实，请检查事实及有效期。
error.hetu.fact_conflict.en: A character has conflicting facts during a provably overlapping interval. Check the values and validity intervals.

error.hetu.duplicate_entity.zh-CN: 设定实体或事实标识重复，请重新打开表单后保存。
error.hetu.duplicate_entity.en: Duplicate entity or fact identifiers were found. Reopen the form and save again.

error.hetu.invalid_source_ref.zh-CN: 原文引用与固定修订不符，请检查引文和完整字符范围。
error.hetu.invalid_source_ref.en: Source evidence does not match its fixed revision. Check the quote and complete character boundaries.

error.hetu.budget_exceeded.zh-CN: 内容或关联复杂度超过当前预算，请缩小操作范围后重试。
error.hetu.budget_exceeded.en: Content size or relationship complexity exceeds the current budget. Reduce the operation scope and try again.

rule.revision.purpose: 历史规则的独立修订号

reference.filter.purpose: 设定关联多选列表的名称筛选

reference.all.purpose: 规则的文档或实体范围没有额外筛选条件

plot.description.zh-CN: 从已有正文提取结构候选，由作者核对原文、确认关联。
plot.description.en: Extract structural candidates from existing text, then verify evidence and references.

plot.saved_source.zh-CN: 提取使用磁盘上的正文修订和当前设定集；编辑器内容需先保存。
plot.saved_source.en: Extraction uses the saved document revision and current story bible. Save editor changes first.

plot.empty.zh-CN: 选择正文，开始整理剧情
plot.empty.en: Select a document to organize its plot

plot.empty_detail.zh-CN: 提取结果保留原文证据；人物、地点和故事时间由作者确认。
plot.empty_detail.en: Each result preserves source evidence. The author confirms characters, locations, and story time.

plot.no_revisions.zh-CN: 这篇正文还没有剧情修订。
plot.no_revisions.en: This document has no saved plot revisions.

plot.coverage_detail.zh-CN: 已扫描 {bytes} 字节 · 设定集修订 {revision}

plot.candidates_note.zh-CN: 扫描完成不代表语义完整。词典命中是候选，空缺项保留未知；叙述先后不等于故事时序。
plot.candidates_note.en: Scanning does not establish semantic completeness. Name matches remain candidates, missing details stay unknown, and narrative order does not establish story time.

plot.stale.zh-CN: 正文或设定集已有新修订。此结果仍引用原修订，可核对后重新提取。
plot.stale.en: The document or story bible has changed. This result retains its original sources; review them or extract again.

plot.no_nodes.zh-CN: 没有识别出结构候选，可以选取原文手动标注。
plot.no_nodes.en: No structural candidates were found. Select an excerpt to annotate it manually.

plot.source_body.en: Source text at a fixed revision

plot.source_fixed.zh-CN: 显示提取时的正文修订，当前编辑器内容不会被替换。
plot.source_fixed.en: This is the source revision used for extraction. The current editor buffer is preserved.

plot.edges_note.zh-CN: 自动连线只表达叙述顺序。因果关系需要作者明确确认。
plot.edges_note.en: Automatic connections describe narrative order. Causal relationships require the author’s explicit confirmation.

plot.correction_note.zh-CN: 校正绑定当前查看的原文与设定集修订，保存为新剧情修订，历史证据保留。
plot.correction_note.en: Corrections use the source and story bible revisions shown here. Saving creates a new plot revision and preserves historical evidence.

plot.select_excerpt.zh-CN: 在下方原文中选中一段文字作为证据，最多 16 KiB。
plot.select_excerpt.en: Select an excerpt below as evidence, up to 16 KiB.

plot.excerpt_too_large.zh-CN: 选中的原文超过 16 KiB，请缩小选区。
plot.excerpt_too_large.en: The excerpt exceeds 16 KiB. Select a smaller range.

plot.speaker_note.zh-CN: 选择说话人时会加入出场人物；保留未知也可保存。
plot.speaker_note.en: Selecting a speaker adds them to the character references. You can leave the speaker unknown.

plot.edge_evidence_note.zh-CN: 以下引用起点节点的原文作为依据。请确认连线含义，因果关系不能成环。
plot.edge_evidence_note.en: The source node’s excerpt is used as evidence. Confirm the relationship; causal connections cannot form a cycle.

error.hetu.plot_cycle.zh-CN: 已确认的因果连线不能成环，请调整起点或终点。
error.hetu.plot_cycle.en: Confirmed causal connections cannot form a cycle. Choose different endpoints.

error.cursor_invalid.zh-CN: 列表已经变化，请刷新后重新查询。
error.cursor_invalid.en: The list has changed. Refresh and query again.

plot.budget.max_bytes.zh-CN: 达到文本字节预算，后续原文未扫描。
plot.budget.max_bytes.en: The text byte budget was reached. Remaining text was not scanned.

plot.budget.max_nodes.zh-CN: 达到节点预算，后续候选未输出。
plot.budget.max_nodes.en: The node budget was reached. Remaining candidates were not emitted.

plot.budget.max_matches.zh-CN: 达到词典匹配预算，后续候选未输出。
plot.budget.max_matches.en: The name matching budget was reached. Remaining candidates were not emitted.

plot.budget.max_duration.zh-CN: 达到处理时限，提取已停止。
plot.budget.max_duration.en: The processing time limit was reached. Extraction stopped.

plot.budget.max_output.zh-CN: 达到输出预算，提取已停止。
plot.budget.max_output.en: The output budget was reached. Extraction stopped.

plot.skip.segment_too_large.zh-CN: 段落超过单条证据预算

plot.method.conflict_marker.zh-CN: 来源：冲突标记或冲突词匹配
plot.method.conflict_marker.en: Source: conflict marker or term match

annotation.enabled.zh-CN: 为这段原文添加结构标注

annotation.note.zh-CN: 仅标注所选原文明确表达的内容。节点经作者确认、语境为实际发生且时间前提齐全时，事实与能力才参与确定性诊断。
annotation.note.en: Annotate only what this excerpt explicitly states. Definite checks require an author-confirmed node, an actual-event context, and the necessary time information.

annotation.capabilities_note.zh-CN: 每行一项，与规则中的能力名称精确一致。启用标注后留空，表示作者确认本段未使用能力。
annotation.capabilities_note.en: One capability per line, matching the rule name exactly. An empty list with annotation enabled means the author confirms that no capability is used here.

plot.relation.story_before.zh-CN: 故事时间早于（作者确认）

validation.description.zh-CN: 按固定修订检查设定冲突、缺失前提和改编提示；报告保留原文证据。
validation.description.en: Check fixed revisions for conflicts, missing prerequisites, and adaptation hints. Reports preserve the source evidence.

validation.empty.zh-CN: 选择剧情修订并执行诊断
validation.empty.en: Select a plot revision to check

validation.empty_detail.zh-CN: 请先在剧情整理中提取节点并核对关联信息。已有报告可从左侧打开。
validation.empty_detail.en: Extract and review nodes in Plot organization first, or open an existing report from the list.

validation.needs_plot.zh-CN: 这篇文档没有剧情修订，请先进入“剧情整理”提取。
validation.needs_plot.en: This document has no plot revisions. Extract one in Plot organization first.

validation.no_reports.zh-CN: 当前剧情修订没有保存的报告。
validation.no_reports.en: No saved reports for this plot revision.

validation.coverage.zh-CN: 已扫描 {bytes} 字节 · 设定集修订 {revision} · 规则集 {version}
validation.coverage.en: Scanned {bytes} bytes · Story bible revision {revision} · Rule set {version}

validation.counts.zh-CN: 检查单元：通过 {passed} · 有问题／提示 {finding} · 缺少前提 {unknown} · 不适用 {not_applicable}
validation.counts.en: Check units: passed {passed} · Findings {finding} · Unknown {unknown} · Not applicable {not_applicable}

validation.stale.zh-CN: 输入已有变化；此报告仅代表当时的固定修订。
validation.stale.en: Inputs have changed. This report describes the fixed revisions recorded at the time.

validation.coverage_note.zh-CN: 完成扫描不代表全文没有问题。候选未确认、结构未标注和未解析内容不能计为通过；处置记录也不会改变报告结论。
validation.coverage_note.en: A completed scan does not establish consistency of the entire text. Unconfirmed candidates, missing annotations, and unparsed text cannot count as passed. Dispositions do not alter the original findings.

validation.rule_coverage.zh-CN: 启用 {enabled} 条规则，已运行 {executed} 条。

validation.unparsed.zh-CN: 格式排除范围 {count} 处；剧情提取未解析范围 {plot_count} 处。
validation.unparsed.en: Excluded format ranges: {count}; unparsed plot ranges: {plot_count}.

validation.no_findings.zh-CN: 当前筛选条件下没有诊断记录。请结合覆盖信息判断检查结果。
validation.no_findings.en: No findings match these filters. Refer to coverage when assessing the result.

validation.disposition_note.zh-CN: 处置绑定本报告的固定证据，保留理由与历史。更新正文或设定后需要重新诊断；不能据此豁免文件完整性错误。
validation.disposition_note.en: Dispositions bind to this report’s fixed evidence and retain the reason and history. Check again after editing the source or story bible. File-integrity errors cannot be waived.

validation.prerequisites.zh-CN: 缺少判定前提，请补充核对信息
validation.prerequisites.en: Missing prerequisites: add or review annotations

validation.fact_conflict.zh-CN: 本段事实与设定集冲突
validation.fact_conflict.en: An asserted fact conflicts with the story bible

validation.world_conflict.zh-CN: 本段能力使用违反地点规则
validation.world_conflict.en: A capability violates the location rule

validation.event_conflict.zh-CN: 故事先后标注与事件规则相反
validation.event_conflict.en: Annotated story order reverses the event rule

validation.mental_density.zh-CN: 心理标记较密集，建议核对可拍摄表达
validation.mental_density.en: Frequent mental-state markers: review how this can be filmed

validation.scene_missing.zh-CN: 未提取到场景节点，建议核对场景信息
validation.scene_missing.en: No scene node was extracted: review scene information

validation.fact_evidence.en: {name} · {predicate}: excerpt asserts “{asserted}”; story bible specifies “{expected}”. At: {time}.

validation.world_evidence.zh-CN: 地点“{location}”禁止使用“{capability}”，本段标注使用了该能力。
validation.world_evidence.en: “{capability}” is forbidden at “{location}”, but this excerpt is annotated as using it.

validation.order_evidence.zh-CN: 作者标注“{before}”发生在“{after}”之前，与规则要求相反。
validation.order_evidence.en: The author annotated “{before}” as preceding “{after}”, reversing the required order.

validation.mental_evidence.zh-CN: 可见正文共 {characters} 个非空白字符，出现 {markers} 次心理标记。
validation.mental_evidence.en: The visible text contains {characters} non-whitespace characters and {markers} mental-state markers.

validation.mental_note.zh-CN: 规则集 1 的提示阈值为至少 3 次，且每千字不少于 10 次。此阈值不是行业标准，也不评价文学质量。
validation.mental_note.en: Rule set 1 flags at least 3 occurrences at a rate of 10 per 1,000 characters. This threshold is not an industry standard or a measure of literary quality.

validation.missing.author_confirmation.en: The node has not been confirmed by the author.

validation.missing.statement_context.zh-CN: 请标注实际发生、梦境、假设或转述等语境。
validation.missing.statement_context.en: Specify whether this is actual, dreamed, hypothetical, or reported.

validation.missing.scope_entities.zh-CN: 规则范围依赖尚未确认的实体关联。
validation.missing.scope_entities.en: The rule scope depends on unconfirmed entity references.

validation.missing.required_references.zh-CN: 请补充规则要求的人物、地点或势力关联。
validation.missing.required_references.en: Add the character, location, or faction references required by the rule.

validation.missing.story_time.zh-CN: 请关联已知故事时间事件。

validation.missing.fact_assertions.zh-CN: 请标注本段明确写出的身份、年龄等事实。
validation.missing.fact_assertions.en: Annotate explicit factual assertions in this excerpt.

validation.missing.applicable_facts.zh-CN: 该时间没有可证明适用的设定事实。
validation.missing.applicable_facts.en: No story-bible fact is provably applicable at this time.

validation.missing.location.en: Associate the location of this excerpt.

validation.missing.plot_nodes.zh-CN: 所选范围缺少可检查的剧情节点。
validation.missing.plot_nodes.en: The selection has no plot nodes that can be checked.

validation.missing.story_order_edges.zh-CN: 请确认故事先后连线；叙述顺序不能作为时间证据。
validation.missing.story_order_edges.en: Confirm story-order edges. Narrative order is not evidence of story time.

validation.missing.scope_text_coverage.zh-CN: 实体范围仅覆盖已确认节点；其余正文范围尚未确认归属。
validation.missing.scope_text_coverage.en: Entity scope covers confirmed nodes only. The remaining text has no confirmed entity association.

validation.missing.source_scan.zh-CN: 原文扫描未完成，不能判为通过。
validation.missing.source_scan.en: The source scan is incomplete and cannot count as passed.

validation.budget.max_bytes.en: The scan byte limit was reached.

validation.budget.max_duration.en: The check time limit was reached.

validation.budget.max_output.en: The report output limit was reached.

validation.budget.chronology_budget.zh-CN: 时间关系检查达到限额。

validation.budget.plot_partial.zh-CN: 输入的剧情提取本身尚未完整，请先处理其覆盖缺口。
validation.budget.plot_partial.en: The input plot extraction is partial. Review its coverage gaps first.

drama.description.zh-CN: 从固定剧情修订整理分集与分场，由作者补齐结构、审核改编。
drama.description.en: Organize fixed plot revisions into episodes and scenes, then review the adaptation.

drama.empty_detail.zh-CN: 先在剧情整理中提取节点，再选择修订建立独立的结构候选。
drama.empty_detail.en: Extract plot nodes first, then select a revision to build a separate structure.

drama.build_note.zh-CN: 每次建立独立候选，保留既有人工结构和剧本。自动分场不添加台词、镜头或新剧情。
drama.build_note.en: Each build creates a separate candidate and preserves existing structures and scripts. It adds no dialogue, shots or plot.

drama.anchors_note.zh-CN: 勾选需要另起一集的节点。默认从首节点开始，按原著顺序保留锚点；片长与节奏由作者判断。
drama.anchors_note.en: Select nodes that start a new episode. The first node starts an episode by default. Anchors follow source order; timing and pacing require author review.

drama.source_note.zh-CN: 固定设定集修订 {revision}，来源引用保留原著修订。
drama.source_note.en: Story bible revision {revision}; evidence retains the fixed source revisions.

drama.stale.zh-CN: 输入已有更新。当前骨架保留历史证据，重新建立候选后由作者比较。
drama.stale.en: Inputs have changed. This structure retains historical evidence; review a new candidate before replacing it.

drama.no_generated_text.zh-CN: 台词与镜头描述留空，正文在独立剧本中编写。
drama.no_generated_text.en: Dialogue and shot descriptions are empty. Write the script as a separate document.

drama.comparison_note.zh-CN: 比较节点映射、结构改动与所选原著修订；不判断对白语义，也不自动迁移改写后的来源。
drama.comparison_note.en: Compares node mappings, structural changes and selected source revisions. It does not assess dialogue meaning or remap rewritten sources.

drama.comparison_stale.zh-CN: 报告输入已有更新，请保留旧证据并重新对比。
drama.comparison_stale.en: Report inputs have changed. Keep the old evidence and run a new comparison.

drama.comparison_limit.zh-CN: 界面展示前 200 项，完整报告保存在工作区的短剧差异目录。
drama.comparison_limit.en: Showing the first 200 items. The full report is saved in the workspace drama comparisons folder.

drama.structure_note.zh-CN: 拆分、合并或移出操作直接保存当前结构的新修订；上方尚未保存的表单修改不随操作提交。
drama.structure_note.en: Split, merge and omit save a new revision of the current structure. Unsaved form edits above are excluded from those operations.

drama.mapping_note.zh-CN: 每个节点最多关联一场。取消关联保留原著，差异报告会列为删减；未分配的节点可以重新关联。
drama.mapping_note.en: Each node maps to at most one scene. Removing a mapping preserves the source and appears as an omission. Unassigned nodes can be mapped again.

drama.unmapped_note.zh-CN: 原文范围尚未形成结构节点，需回到剧情整理补标；它不表示原著被删除。
drama.unmapped_note.en: This source range has no structural nodes. Annotate it in Plot; it does not mean the source was deleted.

drama.diff.modified.zh-CN: 结构关联与原著标注不同

drama.pending_note.zh-CN: 有尚未确认结果的结构操作，请先使用原请求恢复。
drama.pending_note.en: Some structure operations have unconfirmed results. Resume their original requests first.

drama.resume_pending.zh-CN: 恢复第 {number} 项结构操作

script.create_note.zh-CN: 从所选骨架建立独立 Fountain 文档，仅包含集号和场景标题。台词、动作、镜头、批注和来源原文均不写入。
script.create_note.en: Create a separate Fountain document with episode sections and scene headings. Dialogue, action, shots, notes and source excerpts are left out.

script.old_structure.zh-CN: 当前查看的是历史或过期结构。新剧本将固定使用这份修订，请确认选择。
script.old_structure.en: This structure is historical or stale. The new script will use this exact revision.

script.mapping_note.zh-CN: 映射绑定建立剧本时的固定修订。可查看初稿场景标题及原著证据；修改正文不会自动迁移这些范围。
script.mapping_note.en: Mappings refer to the initial script revision. View its scene headings and original evidence. Editing the script does not move these ranges.

script.mapping_stale.zh-CN: 正文、骨架或来源已有变化；此处仅展示固定初稿的历史映射。
script.mapping_stale.en: The script, structure or sources have changed. These mappings show the fixed initial revision.

error.hetu.format_unrepresentable.zh-CN: 标题或地点含有不能直接表示为 Fountain 结构的空白或控制标记，请修改对应字段。
error.hetu.format_unrepresentable.en: A title or location contains whitespace or control markers that cannot be represented directly in Fountain. Edit the relevant field.

script.source_fixed.zh-CN: 这是建立剧本时的固定初稿，当前编辑缓冲保持不变。
script.source_fixed.en: This is the fixed initial script revision. The current editor buffer is preserved.
script.source_fixed.purpose: 剧本初稿固定标题定位说明

review.pending.zh-CN: 有操作结果尚未确认，请先恢复原操作。
review.pending.en: An operation has an unconfirmed result. Resume it before making new changes.

review.provenance.zh-CN: 提交来源：{source} · {date} · 状态修订 {revision}

review.stale.zh-CN: 关联来源或当前正文已有变化。请核对固定证据，批准新稿前需重新提交。
review.stale.en: Related sources or the working text have changed. Review the fixed evidence and submit an updated draft before a new approval.

review.compare.en: Compare with approved text or baseline

review.report_note.zh-CN: 诊断只覆盖报告列出的检查。未确认事实、语境或部分扫描需要作者人工核对。
review.report_note.en: Diagnostics cover only the listed checks. Unconfirmed facts, context and partial scans require author review.

review.view_report.zh-CN: 查看检查提示与处理记录

review.private.zh-CN: 作者私密批注（不向 Agent 展示）

review.coverage.zh-CN: 人工核对说明（覆盖不足或尚不能判断的部分）
review.coverage.en: Manual review note for incomplete coverage or unknowns

review.comments.zh-CN: 审核说明与修改意见（AI 工具可读取）
review.comments.en: Review notes and feedback (visible to AI tools)

review.decision_note.zh-CN: 通过只记录参考稿审核结果。采纳到写作稿、确认定稿须分别操作；撤回审核不会改动正文或已有定稿。
review.decision_note.en: Approval records a reference-draft review only. Adoption and finalization are separate actions. Withdrawing a review changes neither the manuscript nor its finalization.

review.compare_note.zh-CN: 以现有定稿为对照；无定稿时使用提交基线。只读对照不会改写正文。
review.compare_note.en: Compare with the approved text, or the submission baseline when there is no approval. This read-only view does not change the manuscript.

review.submit_note.zh-CN: 将当前已保存的正文另存为待审参考稿。原正文继续保留，提交不等于定稿。
review.submit_note.en: Submit the saved text revision as a separate draft. The manuscript is preserved. Submission does not approve it.

review.rewrite_note.zh-CN: 新内容会另存为返工参考稿，与原稿关联。旧稿和审核意见继续保留，提交时重新核对原稿版本。
review.rewrite_note.en: Revised text becomes a new draft linked to the original. Earlier text and feedback are preserved, and submission baselines are checked again.

error.hetu.review_evidence_required.zh-CN: 通过审核前，请先选择这份参考稿的有效检查报告。
error.hetu.review_evidence_required.en: Select a valid diagnostic report for this draft before approval.

error.hetu.review_coverage_required.zh-CN: 请记录部分覆盖或未知前提的人工核对理由。
error.hetu.review_coverage_required.en: Record why you accept partial coverage or unknown prerequisites.

error.hetu.review_conflict.zh-CN: 仍有未获允许例外的确定性错误，请先修复或处置具体问题。
error.hetu.review_conflict.en: Certain errors still require correction or an allowed, recorded exception.

review.diff_budget.zh-CN: 文本超过逐行差异预览预算，请切换并排核对。
review.diff_budget.en: The text exceeds the line comparison budget. Use the side-by-side view.

review.diff_limit.zh-CN: 显示前 400 处变化，完整正文可在并排核对中阅读。
review.diff_limit.en: Showing the first 400 changes. Read the full text in the side-by-side view.

review.fixed_draft.zh-CN: 正在核对这份参考稿的原文版本，标注不会改写正文。
review.fixed_draft.en: Reviewing the fixed draft. Annotations do not change its text.

review.annotations_validated.zh-CN: 新诊断已保存。关闭窗口后可在审核工作台选择新报告。
review.annotations_validated.en: A new report is saved. Close this window to select it in the review workbench.

git.init_note.zh-CN: 为当前作品建立独立的本地 Git 仓库。首次快照需要单独审阅和提交。
git.init_note.en: Create a separate local Git repository for this workspace. Review and commit the first snapshot separately.

git.init_confirm.zh-CN: 为当前作品启用版本管理？
git.init_confirm.en: Enable version history for this workspace?

git.index_note.zh-CN: 快照比较已保存文件与上一版本；原有 Git 暂存区独立保留。
git.index_note.en: Snapshots compare saved files with HEAD. Your existing Git staging area is preserved.

git.clean.zh-CN: 已保存文件与当前版本一致。
git.clean.en: Saved files match the current version.

git.identity_note.zh-CN: 名称与邮箱会写入 Git 历史，并随仓库同步。
git.identity_note.en: Your name and email become part of Git history and travel with the repository.

git.prepare_note.zh-CN: 先固定文件和提交身份，再核对范围并确认提交。
git.prepare_note.en: Freeze the files and identity, then review the scope and confirm the commit.

git.stale.zh-CN: 文件或目标版本已变化，请返回准备新快照。
git.stale.en: Files or the target revision changed. Prepare a new snapshot.

git.excluded_count.zh-CN: 未纳入本次提交：{count} 项

git.confirm_note.zh-CN: 仅提交上列固定文件，不推送远端。批准有效期为 15 分钟；文件或分支变化后须重新审阅。
git.confirm_note.en: Commit only the fixed files listed above, locally. Approval lasts 15 minutes; file or branch changes require a new review.

git.commit_confirm.zh-CN: 提交当前审阅的版本快照？

git.binary_note.zh-CN: 该文件为二进制或超过文本预览上限，仅展示文件大小。
git.binary_note.en: This file is binary or exceeds the text preview limit. Only sizes are shown.

git.diff_budget.zh-CN: 差异列表达到展示上限，可展开查看可用的全文。
git.diff_budget.en: The difference summary reached its display limit. Expand the available full text.

error.hetu.git_not_initialized.zh-CN: 此作品尚未启用版本管理。
error.hetu.git_not_initialized.en: Version history is not enabled for this workspace.

error.hetu.git_failure.zh-CN: Git 操作失败，请检查仓库完整性与访问权限。
error.hetu.git_failure.en: Git failed. Check repository integrity and access permissions.

error.hetu.git_conflict.zh-CN: 仓库存在合并或冲突状态，请先处理。
error.hetu.git_conflict.en: Resolve the repository merge or conflict state first.

error.hetu.nothing_to_commit.zh-CN: 所选文件与当前版本一致，没有可提交变更。
error.hetu.nothing_to_commit.en: The selected files match HEAD; there is nothing to commit.

error.hetu.secret_detected.zh-CN: 文件含已知凭据或密钥，已停止展示和提交。
error.hetu.secret_detected.en: A known credential or key was detected. Preview and commit are blocked.

error.hetu.author_confirmation_required.zh-CN: 请由作者在本机审阅并批准当前快照。
error.hetu.author_confirmation_required.en: The author must review and approve this snapshot on this device.

error.result_unknown.zh-CN: 结果尚未确认，请保留原操作并恢复查询。
error.result_unknown.en: The outcome is unconfirmed. Keep and recover the original operation.

git.diff_file.purpose: 差异按钮的辅助功能名称

media.empty.zh-CN: 此列表没有线索或素材
media.empty.en: No cues or media in this list

media.select.zh-CN: 选择线索或素材查看详情

media.historical.zh-CN: 当前显示历史修订，仅供查看。

media.delivery_allowed.zh-CN: 权利声明允许嵌入交付包；交付时仍需核验材料。
media.delivery_allowed.en: The rights declaration permits embedding; the material must still be verified at export.

media.delivery_excluded.zh-CN: 默认交付仅列元数据，不嵌入此素材。
media.delivery_excluded.en: Default delivery includes metadata only; this asset is excluded.

media.signature_note.zh-CN: 已核对文件格式标识与校验值；这不代表完整解码、安全扫描或版权验证。
media.signature_note.en: File signature and digest checked; this is not full decoding, a security scan, or copyright verification.

media.sources_stale.zh-CN: 正文已有新修订；以下引文仍指向保存时的固定版本。
media.sources_stale.en: The text has newer revisions; these quotes remain bound to their original revisions.

media.no_assets.zh-CN: 没有关联素材。可先保存线索描述，再导入素材。
media.no_assets.en: No linked assets. You can save the description and add media later.

media.asset_stale.zh-CN: 素材说明或权利已变化，请核对当前修订。
media.asset_stale.en: Asset metadata or rights have changed. Review the current revision.

media.preview_unavailable.zh-CN: 此格式或大小不提供内嵌预览。原文件仍保存在作品目录中。
media.preview_unavailable.en: An inline preview is unavailable for this format or size. The original file remains in the workspace.

media.source_uri_note.zh-CN: 只记录页面地址，不下载内容；请移除账号、密码、查询参数与片段。
media.source_uri_note.en: Records the page address without downloading it. Remove credentials, query parameters, and fragments.

media.redistribute.zh-CN: 声明允许将文件嵌入交付包
media.redistribute.en: Declare permission to embed the file in delivery bundles

media.rights_note.zh-CN: 权利信息由作者声明。未知或仅供参考的文件默认不嵌入交付包。
media.rights_note.en: Rights information is declared by the author. Unconfirmed and reference-only files are excluded from bundles by default.

media.description.zh-CN: 收藏故事的画面与声音，保留灵感的来源。
media.description.en: Collect visual and musical references with their sources.

media.narrative_note.zh-CN: 从已保存正文选择引文；此操作不改写正文。
media.narrative_note.en: Select quotes from saved text. Linking a passage does not modify it.

media.select_quote.zh-CN: 在原文中选中要关联的段落。
media.select_quote.en: Select the passage to link in the text below.

error.hetu.unsupported_media.zh-CN: 不支持此媒体签名或容器。请选择 PNG、JPEG、GIF、WebP、WAV、FLAC、MP3、Ogg 音频、M4A、MP4 或 MOV 文件。
error.hetu.unsupported_media.en: Unsupported media signature or container. Choose PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, WAV, FLAC, MP3, Ogg audio, M4A, MP4, or MOV.

error.hetu.rights_confirmation_required.zh-CN: 允许交付需要选择作者拥有或已许可，并填写再分发依据。
error.hetu.rights_confirmation_required.en: Embedding requires author-owned or licensed rights and a redistribution statement.

shell.motto.zh-CN:
设定有据，
创作有序。
shell.motto.en:
A clear foundation.
Room to create.

shell.canon_note.zh-CN: 整个作品共用作者确认的设定。
shell.canon_note.en: Author-defined canon shared across the workspace.

shell.not_checked.zh-CN: 当前章节尚无诊断报告。
shell.not_checked.en: No diagnostic report for this chapter yet.

shell.reference_note.zh-CN: 人物 / 世界观 / 时间线

shell.checks_note.zh-CN: 诊断附带来源与覆盖范围，不能代替作者的文学判断。
shell.checks_note.en: Checks cite sources and coverage. They do not replace your literary judgment.

shell.coverage.not_applicable.purpose: Mac 原生界面：诊断规则不适用计数

library.search.en: Search title, pen name or genre

library.local.zh-CN:
作品保存在各自的本地目录。
书库记录你选择的作品。
library.local.en:
Each book has its own local folder.
Your library lists the books you choose.

library.empty_detail.zh-CN: 新建小说，或将已有的河图洛书作品加入书库。每部作品独立保存。
library.empty_detail.en: Create a novel or add an existing Hetu Luoshu book. Each book is stored independently.

novel.initialize_detail.zh-CN: 确认作品资料后，将已有小说章节按创建顺序收录到目录。正文、修订与设定集保持原样。
novel.initialize_detail.en: Confirm the book details to catalog existing novel chapters in creation order. Manuscripts, revisions and the Story Bible are preserved.

novel.structure_detail.zh-CN: 调整分卷与章节顺序。章节的正文和原文引用不随重排变化。
novel.structure_detail.en: Organize volumes and chapter order. Reordering preserves manuscript content and source references.

error.library.invalidRecord.zh-CN: 书库记录损坏或格式不受支持，请保留文件并检查。
error.library.invalidRecord.en: The library catalog is damaged or unsupported. Preserve the file and inspect it.

error.library.unavailable.zh-CN: 无法访问书库或作品文件夹。请确认磁盘已连接、目录权限可用，再重试。
error.library.unavailable.en: The library or book folder is unavailable. Check the disk and folder access, then try again.

error.library.busy.zh-CN: 另一窗口正在更新书库，请稍后刷新。
error.library.busy.en: Another window is updating the library. Refresh shortly.

error.library.duplicateWorkspace.zh-CN: 相同作品身份已登记在另一可用目录。请使用书库中的原作品；独立副本需要新的作品身份。
error.library.duplicateWorkspace.en: This book identity is already registered at another available folder. Open the registered book; an independent copy needs its own identity.

error.library.wrongWorkspace.zh-CN: 所选目录的作品身份与书库记录不符，请重新选择正确作品。
error.library.wrongWorkspace.en: The selected folder does not match the book identity in the library. Choose the correct book.

error.hetu.novel_initialization_required.zh-CN: 请先在作品资料页确认初始化小说目录。
error.hetu.novel_initialization_required.en: Confirm and initialize the novel catalog in Book Details first.

library.book_count.purpose: 书库作品数量与标题辅助说明

novel.details_description.zh-CN: 每一部作品，都有自己的故事。

review.description.zh-CN: 核对参考稿、原文差异与修改意见，决定保留、返工或采纳。
review.description.en: Review references, changes and feedback; keep, request changes, or adopt selected text.

review.empty_detail.zh-CN: 选择一份参考稿，核对原文、检查提示和批注，再决定如何使用。
review.empty_detail.en: Select a reference draft to review its text, findings and comments before deciding how to use it.

media.empty_detail.zh-CN: 添加视觉或配乐线索，也可以导入已有素材，为故事积累参考。
media.empty_detail.en: Add visual or music cues, or import existing media to build your reference collection.

git.description.zh-CN: 留住创作的每一个重要时刻。
git.description.en: Keep a record of the moments that shape your story.

git.empty_detail.zh-CN: 初始化本地版本库后，可以预览变更、比较差异并保存创作快照。
git.empty_detail.en: Initialize a local repository to preview changes, compare differences, and save snapshots.

novel.empty_detail.zh-CN: 从左侧新建一个章节，或先整理分卷与大纲，开始你的故事。
novel.empty_detail.en: Create a chapter from the sidebar, or start by organizing volumes and outlines.

settings.applies_immediately.zh-CN: 设置自动保存，并立即应用到所有河图洛书窗口。
settings.applies_immediately.en: Settings are saved automatically and apply to all Hetu Luoshu windows.

settings.indent.zh-CN: 小说段落首行缩进两字
settings.indent.en: Indent novel paragraphs by two characters

settings.preview_text.zh-CN:
雨落在窗边，故事从这一刻开始。
远处的灯亮了，有人正踏着夜色归来。
settings.preview_text.en:
Rain brushes the window. A story begins here.
A light shines in the distance as someone returns through the night.

settings.display_only.zh-CN: 排版只改变显示，不向正文添加空格。Fountain 剧本保持场次与对白的原有对齐。
settings.display_only.en: Typography changes the display without adding spaces to your text. Fountain scripts keep their scene and dialogue alignment.

settings.git_note.zh-CN: 这里只保存本机的提交署名，不修改系统 Git 配置，也不执行提交或同步。
settings.git_note.en: This stores a local commit identity. It does not change system Git configuration, commit, or sync.

settings.local_note.zh-CN: 作品保存在各自的本地目录。河图洛书不内置内容生成模型或生成服务接口。
settings.local_note.en: Books remain in their own local folders. Hetu Luoshu does not include content generation models or generation APIs.

adoption.note.zh-CN: 先选择需要的段落，再查看采纳效果。采纳后仍是写作稿，定稿需要你另行确认。
adoption.note.en: Choose the passages you want, then preview the result. Adoption updates the working draft; finalization is a separate author decision.

adoption.selection_hint.zh-CN: 在左侧选择参考段落，在右侧选择替换内容或放置插入位置。
adoption.selection_hint.en: Select reference text on the left and a replacement range or insertion point on the right.

adoption.baseline_changed.zh-CN: 原稿在参考稿提交后有过修改，请结合提交时的原稿核对。
adoption.baseline_changed.en: The manuscript changed after submission. Review the original submission context as well.

adoption.invalid_selection.zh-CN: 请选择完整的参考段落，并核对原稿中的替换位置。
adoption.invalid_selection.en: Select valid reference text and check the target range in the manuscript.

adoption.title_required.zh-CN: 请填写新章节或剧本的标题。
adoption.title_required.en: Enter a title for the new chapter or script.

adoption.initialize_novel.zh-CN: 请先在作品资料中设置小说信息，再采纳为新章节。
adoption.initialize_novel.en: Set up the book details before adopting into a new chapter.

finalization.note.zh-CN: 定稿保留你确认的这一版。以后继续写作不会覆盖它，也不会自动投稿。
finalization.note.en: Finalization preserves the revision you confirm. Later editing keeps it intact and does not publish your work.

finalization.coverage_counts.zh-CN: 共 {findings} 项提示，另有 {unknown} 项需要人工核对。
finalization.coverage_counts.en: {findings} findings and {unknown} checks requiring manual review.

finalization.ready.zh-CN: 已具备定稿条件，请核对全文后确认。
finalization.ready.en: Ready for finalization. Review the full text before confirming.

finalization.withdraw_note.zh-CN: 撤回后保留正文和历次定稿记录，只取消当前定稿。
finalization.withdraw_note.en: The manuscript and finalization history are preserved. Only the current finalization is withdrawn.

finalization.new_writing.zh-CN: 写作稿有新修改 · 旧定稿保留
finalization.new_writing.en: New working revision · earlier final preserved

agent.catalog_error.zh-CN: 无法读取随附套件，请检查应用资源。
agent.catalog_error.en: Unable to read bundled suites. Check the app resources.

agent.manual_note.zh-CN: 可以直接创作。选择客户端后可检查对应题材套件。
agent.manual_note.en: You can write directly. Choose a client to check its genre suite.

agent.default_note.zh-CN: 默认客户端仅用于新作品。更改默认值不会改变已有作品的关联。
agent.default_note.en: The default applies to new books. Existing book associations stay as selected.

agent.work_note.zh-CN: 客户端和套件选择保存在本机，逐作品独立；切换不改变作品内容或任务授权。
agent.work_note.en: Client and suite choices are local to each book. Content and task permissions stay intact.

agent.state.notFound.zh-CN: 未发现安装记录或包文件
agent.state.notFound.en: No Installation Record or Package Found

agent.state.filesFound.zh-CN: 已发现包文件，安装状态待验证

agent.state.registered.zh-CN: 已发现本机登记与包文件

agent.state.partial.zh-CN: 套件不完整，缺少部分 Skills

agent.state.ambiguous.zh-CN: 发现多个包，请选择实际目录
agent.state.ambiguous.en: Multiple Packages Found; Choose the Actual One

agent.version_differs.zh-CN: 本机包与随附版本不同，请在客户端核对更新。
agent.version_differs.en: Local and bundled versions differ. Check updates in your client.

agent.evidence_note.zh-CN: 包文件与启用配置只证明本机可见信息。请在客户端的新会话核对 Skills 和任务连接。
agent.evidence_note.en: Package files and enable settings show local evidence. Verify Skills and the task connection in a new client session.

agent.choose_package_note.zh-CN: 选择实际使用的插件根目录，包含 plugin.json 或 .codex-plugin/plugin.json。
agent.choose_package_note.en: Choose the actual plugin root containing plugin.json or .codex-plugin/plugin.json.

agent.guide.codex.zh-CN: 查看随附套件，在 Codex 的插件目录按官方指南添加本地来源并安装。军事题材选择“河图洛书·军事”整套包。若已有多个缓存版本，请选择客户端实际使用的包目录；安装后开始新会话核对 Skills。
agent.guide.codex.en: Show the bundled suite, then follow the official guide to add a local source and install in Codex. Use the complete Hetu Luoshu · Military package for military fiction. If several cached versions exist, select the actual package used by your client. Start a new session to verify Skills.

agent.guide.other.zh-CN: 查看随附套件，将整套 skills 目录和 references 一并保留，按所选客户端的官方方式导入。WorkBuddy 的安装位置及能力以其实际版本为准；河图洛书不会套用其他产品的配置路径。导入后选择实际包目录检查文件。
agent.guide.other.en: Show the bundled suite and keep its complete skills and references directories together when importing with your client’s official method. WorkBuddy locations and capabilities depend on its actual version. After import, choose the actual package directory to inspect the files.

agent.guide.scope.zh-CN: 河图洛书不会自动修改全局客户端配置。包内方法与任务 MCP 分开接入：先在河图洛书准备明确任务，再按该任务提供的连接范围使用；文件检测不代表已连接或已生成。
agent.guide.scope.en: Hetu Luoshu does not change global client settings automatically. Prepare a specific task, then use its scoped MCP connection. File detection does not mean a connection or generation has completed.

agent.lock_differs.zh-CN: Lock 与 manifest 版本不同；当前包版本以 manifest 为准，宿主加载待验证。
agent.lock_differs.en: Lock and manifest versions differ. The package version comes from the manifest; verify host loading separately.

agent.skill_version.purpose: Mac 原生界面：Skill 随套件发布的版本

creative.save_first.zh-CN: 请先保存修订，再确认本次可改范围；未保存内容不会自动外发。
creative.save_first.en: Save a revision before choosing the edit scope. Unsaved text is not shared automatically.

creative.context_note.zh-CN: 本章已保存原文、作品资料和勾选内容会作为参考；只有上方明确列出的范围允许改动。
creative.context_note.en: The saved chapter, book profile and checked sources are shared as context. Only the explicitly listed ranges may be changed.

creative.request.zh-CN: 修改目标与需要保留的表达
creative.request.en: Revision request and what to preserve

creative.handoff_note.zh-CN: 河图洛书准备任务，完整对话与生成在你选择的外部客户端进行。先配置本任务 MCP 连接；不使用 MCP 时按提示词写回固定结果目录。
creative.handoff_note.en: Hetu Luoshu prepares the task. Conversation and generation happen in your chosen external client. Configure the task MCP connection, or return files to the fixed inbox.

creative.copied.zh-CN: 提示词已复制，请到所选客户端继续。
creative.copied.en: Prompt copied. Continue in your chosen client.

creative.connection_copied.zh-CN: 连接配置已复制，请按客户端的 MCP 配置格式添加；软件不会修改全局配置。
creative.connection_copied.en: Connection JSON copied. Add it using your client’s MCP configuration format. Global settings are not changed by the app.

creative.close_note.zh-CN: 结束后撤销本任务的后续 MCP 访问，保留已收到的候选；不会取消外部生成。
creative.close_note.en: Closing revokes further MCP access for this task and keeps received candidates. It does not cancel external generation.

creative.select_helper.zh-CN: 选择随河图洛书提供的 hetu-mcp 可执行文件。这里只生成连接说明，不运行所选文件。
creative.select_helper.en: Select the hetu-mcp executable supplied with Hetu Luoshu. This only creates connection instructions; it does not run the selected file.

creative.stale.zh-CN: 基于较早版本，仅供参考。请与当前写作稿重新比较。
creative.stale.en: Based on an earlier revision. Compare it with your current working text.

creative.adoption_note.zh-CN: 未勾选的改动保留原文。采纳后生成新写作修订，旧定稿不变；也可以只作参考自行改写。
creative.adoption_note.en: Unchecked changes keep your original wording. Adoption creates a working revision and preserves the final version. You may also use this as reference and write your own text.

creative.error.scopeChanged.zh-CN: 作品上下文已变化，请回当前作品重新发起任务。
creative.error.scopeChanged.en: The book context changed. Start the task again from the current book.

creative.error.saveRequired.zh-CN: 请先完成输入并处理未保存稿，再准备或采纳改动。
creative.error.saveRequired.en: Finish text composition and resolve unsaved changes before preparing or adopting edits.

creative.error.invalidSelection.zh-CN: 选区或基线已变化，请重新选择并预览；整章授权也需明确选择。
creative.error.invalidSelection.en: The selection or baseline changed. Select and preview again. Whole-chapter access must also be explicit.

creative.error.missingClient.zh-CN: 请先选择本次使用的外部客户端。
creative.error.missingClient.en: Choose an external client for this task.

creative.error.invalidResult.zh-CN: 任务或连接数据无效，请重新检查。
creative.error.invalidResult.en: The task or connection data is invalid. Check it again.

creative.error.budgetExceeded.zh-CN: 结果清单超过读取上限，请缩小单批结果。
creative.error.budgetExceeded.en: The result manifest exceeds the read limit. Use a smaller batch.

agent.cover_install.zh-CN: 封面协作 · 安装 Skills

agent.install_scope.codex.zh-CN: 将所选完整套件安装到本机 Codex，并启用对应插件。安装使用 Codex 官方 CLI 管理本机插件来源与配置；不会授予作品或任务读取权限。
agent.install_scope.codex.en: Install and enable the complete selected suite in local Codex using its official CLI. This does not grant access to books or tasks.

agent.install_scope.workbuddy.zh-CN: WorkBuddy 将安装到下方配置目录的 skills 子目录。完整题材包保留全部方法和参考资料；文件安装与当前会话加载分别核对。其他客户端可在安装说明中查看导入方式。
agent.install_scope.workbuddy.en: For WorkBuddy, install the complete genre package into the skills subdirectory below. File installation and current session loading are checked separately. Other clients can use the import guide.

agent.install_scope.other.zh-CN: 请选择 Codex 或 WorkBuddy 安装完整题材套件。其他客户端请通过其官方入口安装，并单独核对 Skills 与 MCP 连接。
agent.install_scope.other.en: Choose Codex or WorkBuddy to install a complete genre suite. For other clients, use their official installation flow and verify skills and MCP separately.

agent.install_success.zh-CN: 套件已安装并启用。请在客户端开始新会话，再连接具体创作任务。
agent.install_success.en: Suite installed and enabled. Start a new client session, then connect a specific creative task.

agent.install_error.clientUnavailable.zh-CN: 未找到可用的客户端安装入口，请选择实际客户端或 CLI。
agent.install_error.clientUnavailable.en: No usable client installer was found. Choose the actual client or CLI.

agent.install_error.invalidPackage.zh-CN: 随附套件缺失或无效，请检查应用资源。
agent.install_error.invalidPackage.en: The bundled suite is missing or invalid. Check the app resources.

agent.install_error.destinationConflict.zh-CN: 目标已有不同内容，已保留原文件。请选择其他目录或先在客户端处理。
agent.install_error.destinationConflict.en: The destination contains different content. Existing files were preserved. Choose another directory or resolve it in the client.

agent.install_error.commandFailed.zh-CN: 安装命令未完成，请检查客户端版本及权限；已有文件和登记已保留，可在客户端核对后继续。
agent.install_error.commandFailed.en: Installation did not complete. Check client version and permissions. Existing files and registration were preserved for inspection.

agent.install_error.verificationFailed.zh-CN: 安装结果未通过回读核验，请在客户端检查原安装记录。
agent.install_error.verificationFailed.en: Installation could not be verified. Check the original installation record in the client.

agent.state.filesInstalled.zh-CN: 套件文件已安装，客户端加载待验证
agent.state.filesInstalled.en: Suite Files Installed; Client Loading Unverified

agent.choose_workbuddy.zh-CN: 选择 WorkBuddy 配置目录…

agent.choose_workbuddy_note.zh-CN: 选择 WorkBuddy 的配置根目录，套件将安装在其 skills 子目录。
agent.choose_workbuddy_note.en: Choose the WorkBuddy configuration root. Suites will be installed in its skills subdirectory.

agent.install_files_success.zh-CN: 完整套件文件已安装并核对。请在 WorkBuddy 中刷新 Skills 或开始新会话检查加载。
agent.install_files_success.en: Complete suite files installed and verified. Refresh Skills in WorkBuddy or start a new session to check loading.

brand.name.purpose: Mac 原生界面：品牌名称
